reason: README offers a CPU llama.cpp GGUF deployment of the ~1B HunyuanOCR model with an OpenAI-compatible server, no gated weights.
demo: docs/llama_cpp.md (linked from README): build llama.cpp, download tencent/HunyuanOCR, convert to GGUF, run llama-server base model only
goal: Build upstream llama.cpp on CPU, download tencent/HunyuanOCR from Hugging Face (exclude v1.0/*, skip DFlash), convert to hyocr-f16.gguf and mmproj-hyocr-f16.gguf via convert_hf_to_gguf.py, and serve with llama-server (section 4.1: port 8080, --alias HYVL, --jinja, -fa on, modest ctx-size). /work/run.sh must start this server in the background and return only once it is ready to answer /v1/chat/completions on 127.0.0.1:8080 with an image input.
check: The hidden test sends a generated image containing text to the server's chat completions endpoint and verifies the response is HTTP 200 and contains the text in the image.
